lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Cold-open a map, pinch and zoom-out until the camera stops; confirm zoom is at least 7.5
Enable a raster underlay and confirm it remains available at zoom 7.5; disable it and confirm it remains hidden
Select the Light map background and inspect an uncovered map area at several zoom levels
Switch to Neutral and back to Light; inspect the same area for gray dots or texture artifacts
value.expected: Camera floor is 7.5 and each enabled raster underlay has style minzoom 7. Visibility remains authoritative, raster sources use their direct URLs without a display proxy or tile transformation, and the Light background is uniformly #FFFFFF at every checked zoom with no gray dots after mode changes.
